text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a single SEV playbook that covers Marketplace listings + SI-assisted deployments. Can we lock channel naming, who runs the war room, and the escalation tree? Thinking shared channel + partner-oncall + our eng-oncall.

alex: +1. Suggest channel pattern: `#partner-{shortname}-sev` for live triage, and a cross-post to `#partnerships-warroom` for exec/status updates. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Question — who is the bridge runner for the first 30–40m? Our usual policy is partner-eng leads initial triage, then hand to platform oncall if it’s infra. For marketplace listing failures, AWS SI may need to be paged too. Do we page them directly or via partner-eng?

sophie: Proposal: partner L1 does initial triage + gathers artifacts. If unresolved after 30m escalate to partner-eng + rwd-platform. After 60m open full war room and add eng-sre. Quick runbook snippet: ```
- 0m: create `#partner-{short}-sev` and invite partner-liaison, rwd-platform, partner-eng
- 5m: collect logs, deploy id, listing id, error snippets
- 30m: escalate to partner-eng + rwd-platform
- 60m: declare MAJOR, open bridge + exec channel
```

jordan: Also add a metadata flag in the incident payload `marketplace_listing: true` so routing can prioritize to the marketplace-capable pool and attach the listing id.

partner-oncall: :robot_face: warroom created: `#partner-aurora-sev` — bridge link: https://meet.redwood/rooms/aurora-2169876543. Invited: @maria @alex @kevin @sophie.

alex: Paging/order suggestion: partner L1 -> partner-eng -> rwd-platform -> eng-sre -> partner-oncall (external) -> execs. If we hit 1hr without progress escalate to Major Ops and notify VP-ops. :rotating_light:

maria: We also need SLAs per partner tier documented. Platinum partners: 30m response, Standard: 2h. Sophie, can you add tiered response times + oncall paging to the playbook?

sophie: Yep. Drafted and added initial section to the doc. Placeholder link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/wiki/Partner-SEV-Playbook (will update). Also recommend only partner-liaison and security can invite guest accounts to the `#partner-*-sev` channels.

kevin: One more: who has permission to escalate to AWS SI? If we allow partner-eng to page them directly we need a checklist they must run first (logs, reproducer). Otherwise page via partner-liaison.

jordan: Agreed. I'll add a short root message template for the war room. Paste: ```
PRODUCT: Redwood Inference API
PARTNER: AuroraCloud (short: aurora)
ENV: staging/prod
LISTING_ID: aurora-rls-2026-03
DEPLOY_ID: deploy-9876
IMPACT: listing creation failed, 500s, affects new customers
ARTIFACTS: /s3/aurora/logs/2169876543, stacktrace.txt
NEXT_STEP: partner-eng triage
```

alex: LGTM. Can we run a tabletop next Wed 10am PT with Aurora and AWS SI to validate the flow?

maria: Yes — I'll schedule and invite partners + ops. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
